# Community Rule Column 8 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** 1QS (Cave 1), Col. 8 | **Condition:** complete

---

**8:1** In the council of the community there shall be twelve men and three priests who are perfect in all

**8:2** that has been revealed from the whole Torah, practicing truth and righteousness

**8:3** and justice and covenant-faithfulness and humility, each man with his neighbor,

**8:4** to preserve faithfulness in the land with steadfast purpose and a broken spirit, and to atone for

**8:5** sin by practicing justice and enduring the affliction of the refining furnace, and to walk with all by the measure of

**8:6** truth and by the regulation of the time. When these exist in Israel,

**8:7** the council of the community shall be established in truth as an eternal planting,

**8:8** a holy house for Israel, and a foundation of the holy of

**8:9** holies for Aaron — true witnesses for judgment, chosen by the will of God to atone

**8:10** for the land and to render to the wicked their recompense. This is the tested wall,

**8:11** the precious cornerstone whose foundations shall not shake nor

**8:12** be moved from their place — a dwelling of the holy of holies

**8:13** for Aaron with knowledge for all, for a covenant of justice and to offer a pleasing fragrance, and a house of

**8:14** perfection and truth in Israel to establish a covenant according to the everlasting statutes. They shall be accepted to atone

**8:15** for the land and to bring judgment against wickedness, and injustice shall be no more. When these have been established

**8:16** in the foundation of the community for two years with perfection of way, they shall be set apart as holy

**8:17** within the council of the men of the community. Every matter hidden from Israel that has been found

**8:18** by the one who searches — he shall not conceal it from them out of fear of a spirit of

**8:19** apostasy. When these things come to pass in the community in Israel according to these

**8:20** regulations, they shall be separated from the midst of the habitation of the men of injustice to go

**8:21** to the wilderness to prepare there the way of the LORD, as it is written:

**8:22** "In the wilderness prepare the way of the LORD; make straight in the desert a highway

**8:23** for our God." This is the study of the Torah which he commanded through Moses, to act

**8:24** according to all that has been revealed from time to time, and as the prophets revealed by his spirit of

**8:25** holiness. Every man from the men of the community, the covenant of

**8:26** the community, who turns aside from any commandment deliberately — he shall not touch the pure food of

**8:27** the men of holiness, nor shall he know any of their counsel until his deeds are purified from all injustice.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Column 8 is the foundational charter of the inner council. "Covenant-faithfulness" is retained for hesed (line 3) per project convention. "Holy of holies" is preserved in its Hebrew superlative form rather than PNEUMA's "most holy" since the temple metaphor is central to the passage. The Isaiah 40:3 quotation (lines 21-23) is rendered following standard biblical translation. "Spirit of holiness" (line 24-25) is preserved over PNEUMA's "holy spirit" to avoid anachronistic trinitarian connotation.*
